name: Non-spherical offset 3R with passive self-aligning slides
verdict: not worth its own GPU sweep: net -0.84 gap vs the in-model spherical control with the same directions (57.95 vs 58.79, inside greedy-drop noise) - the slides cost 6.4, R1/R2 offsets buy back 7.3; the gain over the 68.93 baseline is the model's free-underside fit (62.58 at the champion directions) and a direction re-tune that belongs to the spherical family (hand d_el -6.4, d_wd +4.1, d_wa +3.6 to its GPU sweep)
limiter: hub 2 (J2 hub): 2 % of its samples in band, median 28 mm off the skin in all 360 configs - its face is set by abduction/flexion 90-150 deg poses at small axial rotation (plane -15..30) where the elevated arm occupies its place (22 skin poses); the J2 fold costs 19 poses (Raise overhead elev 124-150 plane 30 axial -55..-60; behind-back plane -60..-90); the slide stage's along-carriage is 23 % in band (median 18 mm) and the stage costs +6.4 gap at fixed directions
note: spec fixed: 3 passive translations, not 2 (3R+2P cannot close on a 3-DOF arm with offset axes; R3-only offsets are the exact exception and score 65.4); best = remote slide stage 5 mm past hub 3 with a ramped neck, all six offsets, re-tuned directions; numbers under jam_contact=1 (before the fix the same config read 49.15 because jams hid contact); pinch: link 1 0.43 mm at plane 15 elev 0 axial -75; bench fast Bench(60,160) | gate (screening log, 360 tries): NOT converged (+5.13 score pts over 2nd half, +2.27 over last third, top5 0.34) -> CMA-ES on the farm with VModel (verifier checks + member-3 riser); red team: riser at neck 5 jams 24/220 poses (59.63 -> 79.75 fast), fixed by neck >= 12.3 mm (k324 neck 13: 58.59); CMA first 48 tries best 54.95 fast (k 403); branch +1 variant 218.54 at k324 directions; flip3 variant no gain (58.54)
v_note: verifier: Bench(110,360) exact path, model re-fitted there with corrected checks (closure residual <= 0.015 deg, + hub3/bridge vs rail/carriage-A and carriage-B vs rail clearances, + the missing member-3 bridge neck->carriage B (8 x 13 mm, 24 samples, 0 % in band, +1.7 gap), dropped-and-jammed poses never taken); Bench(60,160): fast 59.63, exact 58.38; why not taken {'fold': 51, 'slide': 0, 'flip': 0, 'closure': 0, 'skin': 40, 'parts': 4, 'contact': 0}; radial-slide guide hardware still unmodelled (not skin-facing)
